title: Sparkly snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles around globe -->
  <g fill="#ffe14d">
    <path d="M15 20 l1.5 4.5 4.5 1.5 -4.5 1.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 -4.5 -4.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5z"/>
    <path d="M82 12 l1.5 4.5 4.5 1.5 -4.5 1.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 -4.5 -4.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5z"/>
    <path d="M88 55 l1.2 3.6 3.6 1.2 -3.6 1.2 -1.2 3.6 -1.2 -3.6 -3.6 -1.2 3.6 -1.2z"/>
    <path d="M10 60 l1.2 3.6 3.6 1.2 -3.6 1.2 -1.2 3.6 -1.2 -3.6 -3.6 -1.2 3.6 -1.2z"/>
    <path d="M78 78 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1z"/>
    <path d="M22 40 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- small dots sparkles -->
  <g fill="#fff7a8">
    <circle cx="14" cy="45" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="35" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="18" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="25" cy="72" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="70" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="30" r="1.2"/>
  </g>
  <!-- base of snow globe -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#8a5a2b"/>
  <rect x="26" y="76" width="48" height="7" rx="3" fill="#a8703a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="24" ry="5" fill="#c98b4a"/>
  <!-- globe glass -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="30" fill="#bfe8ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d="M30 30 Q36 22 46 24" stroke="#e8f7ff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M32 36 Q35 31 41 30" stroke="#e8f7ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- snow inside at bottom -->
  <path d="M22 68 Q30 60 40 65 Q50 58 60 63 Q70 58 78 68 L78 72 Q50 78 22 72 Z" fill="#eef7ff"/>
  <!-- little snowman -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="4.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="3.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="49" cy="51" r="0.8" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="51.5" cy="51" r="0.8" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <path d="M50 52.5 l3 1 -3 0.8z" fill="#ff8c2b"/>
  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="57" r="0.7" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="0.7" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="65" r="0.8" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d="M44 57 l-5 -4" stroke="#8a5a2b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 57 l5 -4" stroke="#8a5a2b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M46.5 54.5 Q50 56.5 53.5 54.5 L54 56 Q50 58 46 56 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <path d="M53 55.5 l2 4" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- hat -->
  <rect x="46" y="47.5" width="8" height="2" rx="0.8" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <rect x="47" y="43" width="6" height="4.5" rx="1" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <!-- little pine trees -->
  <path d="M33 68 l4 -10 4 10 -2 0 3 6 -10 0 3 -6z" fill="#2d9e5f"/>
  <path d="M64 68 l3.5 -8 3.5 8 -2 0 2.5 5 -8 0 2.5 -5z" fill="#2d9e5f"/>
  <!-- snowflakes inside -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="38" cy="40" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="38" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="44" r="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="46" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="48" r="0.9"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="52" r="1.1"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="55" r="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="58" r="0.9"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="58" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="68" cy="42" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="42" r="0.9"/>
  </g>
  <!-- glass edge accent -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="30" fill="none" stroke="#a8d8f0" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
